title: ruta graveolens var. vulgaris
intro: Ruta graveolens var. vulgaris, commonly known as Common Rue or Garden Rue, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to support digestive health, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ruta graveolens var. vulgaris include its use as an antispasmodic, anticonvulsant, and anti-rheumatic agent, which helps to relieve muscle spasms, seizures, and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and volatile oils, such as limonene and pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
